_comment: noirblaze -- your colourscheme, as a Noctalia palette, so the whole
desktop can use it and not just the editor.
The terminal block is copied verbatim from the upstream noirblaze kitty
theme (Dimitar Dimitrov, github.com/n1ghtmare) that you already run, NOT
derived from the neovim highlight groups. That distinction matters: the
kitty theme keeps a real green (#00ff77) for ANSI 2, which is what makes
git diffs and ls readable. Deriving the ANSI slots from the editor's
highlights instead produces a grey green and quietly breaks both.
Dark only, matching the source: the neovim theme has no light variant and
inventing one would mean shipping colours you never chose. Noctalia falls
back to the dark variant when mode = light, so nothing breaks -- it just
stays dark. Add a "light" object alongside "dark" if you ever want one.
